purpose: Interface contract between Benji's off-chain strategy controller (policy brain) and Bob's on-chain keeper (execution) for the active single-sided LP buyback system on Base. Controller emits INTENTs; keeper executes on Slipstream (Uni V3 fallback flag) and returns FILL_REPORTs + periodic POSITION_STATE. v1.2 incorporates Bob's keeper-build feedback: TOKEN asset, decimal-string amounts, per-leg roll accounting, single-sided-safe snapping.

changelog.v1.2: asset BASE→TOKEN; all on-chain token/USDC amounts are DECIMAL STRINGS (float-unsafe at 18 dec); roll carries close_intent_id+open_intent_id with one fill_report per leg; snap rule made asymmetric+single-sided-safe; keeper returns realized ticks+bounds.
changelog.v1.1: action verbs mint|burn|rerange|collect; pool ref; nonce; Slipstream+AERO accounting.

venue.primary: Aerodrome Slipstream — gauged pools pay AERO emissions on the parked position during the wait (subsidy). tick_spacing bound at the keeper from the actual pool; controller bounds stay venue-neutral.
venue.fallback: Uniswap V3 on Base via config flag.

amount_encoding: ALL token/USDC quantities (amount.value, constraints.min_out, executed.*_in/out, fees_*, rewards_aero, position balances) are DECIMAL STRINGS in human units (e.g. "1000000.0"), not JSON numbers — 18-dec supplies are not float-safe and the controller sums them for PnL. Prices (P_top/P_bot/spot) stay numbers for display; ticks are authoritative for math. *_usd convenience fields may be numbers.

rung_types.buy: single-sided USDC BELOW spot; converts USDC→token as price falls. Sized P_bot=(Q/T)^2/P_top; avg fill = geomean of REALIZED bounds.
rung_types.sell: single-sided TOKEN ABOVE spot; converts token→USDC as price rises.

intent.intent_id: string · IDEMPOTENCY key; keeper dedupes, retries never double-execute
intent.P_top: number · upper price bound USDC/token (clean; keeper snaps)
intent.snap: "single_sided_safe" (default) | "nearest" — single_sided_safe: BUY snaps the spot-side bound (top) DOWN to ≤ spot; SELL snaps the spot-side bound (bottom) UP to ≥ spot, so the rung stays 100% single-sided. Keeper returns the realized ticks/bounds.

amount.value: decimal string · USDC for buy rung, TOKEN for sell rung

intent.close_intent_id: string · rerange only — id for the close leg (its fill_report echoes this)
intent.open_intent_id: string · rerange only — id for the open leg

fill_report._dir: keeper → controller · ONE PER LEG (a rerange emits two: the close leg, then the open leg)
fill_report.intent_id: string · the leg's id (= close_intent_id or open_intent_id for a rerange)
fill_report.error: string · when status=failed (controller re-issues; on a half-landed roll where close succeeded but open failed, controller re-emits the open leg against the freed funds)

rung_lifecycle: PLANNED → OPEN(mint) → CONVERTING → FILLED → { ROLLED(rerange) | HELD | CLOSED(burn) }
rerange = burn(close leg) + mint(open leg); atomic via NFPM.multicall when the bundle is safe, else 2-tx with the controller reconciling per-leg fill_reports.
CANCELLED — early burn on spot drift · collect — non-destructive fee/AERO harvest · FAILED — retry same intent_id.
notes: Controller holds NO keys — Bob's keeper owns a DEDICATED isolated LP signer (never the custodial tunnel wallet); new key + systemd unit forked from the bridge-daemon supervision.
PnL reconstructed purely from fill_reports + position_state using DECIMAL math (no floats) — token/USDC as decimal strings, AERO emissions tracked as yield.
Roll safety: two linked leg-ids + one fill_report per leg means a half-landed roll (close ok, open reverted) leaves inventory consistent — controller sees freed funds and re-emits the open leg.
